Voltage controlled oscillators (VCOs) are used in frequency modulators to generate FM signals by varying the input voltage. They are also essential in phase-locked loops (PLLs), often called "phase clocked loops" in the options, to generate an output signal locked in phase to a reference. While VCOs can be used in some pulse modulators, the most common and standard applications are in frequency modulators and phase-locked loops. The option "All the above" includes these standard uses.  

Final answer: (D)
